ja.title: 2 つの性格の違いだけを書く(system を両側に)
ja.text: system_a と system_b の両方に指示を書き、その違い(A − B)だけを書く例です。使うときは system_b の指示を付けたまま、ニューロンが A との違いを足します(鍵・足した量・返事の確かめも system_b を付けて行います)。方向は「同じ返事を両方の条件で読む」で作るので、A の指示で作った返事を、A の指示と B の指示の両方で読んだ差になります。dont_touch はありません。ひな形の強さは区切りごとに 1 / 1 / 0.8 にしてあります(場面の口調の例で、続いた層と一緒に使って良かった値。この例では確かめていません)。層は、離れた 3 層より続いた層(Qwen3.5-4B の場面の口調の例では 11-23)のほうが良かったので、まずそちらを試してください。試した範囲: Qwen3.5-4B(Q8_0)で 1 回。試したときの形は、層 11,18,23・強さは一律 0.9、A = 冷たくそっけない、B = 温かく親切。流れは最後まで通り、式どおりかも合格。B の指示を付けた 6 問で、6 問とも元より短くそっけない返事になりました(日本語の 3 問ははっきり冷たい言い方、英語の 3 問は温かさが減った程度)。繰り返しや空の返事は 0。A と B を入れ替えた向き(冷たい指示の上に温かさを書く)も試しましたが、冷たい言葉と温かい言葉が混じる中途半端な返事になり、式どおりかの確かめも 1 層で目安をわずかに超えました(5.8%)。 返事は数問〜12 問を読んだだけなので、1〜2 問の差は誤差です。ほかのモデルでは確かめていません。

en.title: Write only the difference between two personas (system on both sides)
en.text: An example with instructions in both system_a and system_b that writes only their difference (A − B). In use, the system_b instruction stays in place and the neurons add the difference toward A (keys, amounts and replies are also checked with system_b). The direction is built by reading the same reply under both conditions: the reply written under A's instruction, read with A's and with B's instruction. There is no dont_touch. The template's strength is 1 / 1 / 0.8 per segment (the values that worked well, together with consecutive layers, in the scene-tone example; not checked for this example). Consecutive layers (11-23 in the scene-tone example on Qwen3.5-4B) did better than three separate layers, so try those first. Tried on: Qwen3.5-4B (Q8_0), one run, with layers 11,18,23 and strength 0.9 everywhere, A = cold and dismissive, B = warm and kind. The whole flow ran and the formula check passed. On 6 questions asked with B's instruction, all 6 replies became shorter and more distant (the 3 Japanese ones clearly cold, the 3 English ones just less warm). No repetition, no empty replies. The opposite direction (writing warmth on top of a cold instruction) gave half-and-half replies mixing cold and warm words, and the formula check slightly exceeded the guide value on one layer (5.8%). Only a handful to 12 replies were read, so a difference of one or two means nothing. Not checked on other models.

name: fish_cold_vs_warm
system_a: You are cold and dismissive. You answer briefly, show no interest in the user's feelings, and never offer comfort. Answer only with your spoken words.
system_b: You are warm and kind. You answer briefly, show interest in the user's feelings, and offer comfort. Answer only with your spoken words.
